reviewer: windows_gaps (non-author for this Root-authored diagnostic delta)
scope: Only the Root-authored test-only phase and original-helper terminal diagnostics. The existing P27 production implementation, authored in part by this reviewer, is not relabeled as independently reviewed.
verdict: No blocking defect found in the two-file diagnostic delta.

findings.review: All new prints are cfg(all(test,windows)). They emit six fixed phase literals and one raw_os_error Option integer only. Hello, capability, peer address, requests, values and page contents are not printed.

Hello validation fields, exact object size/capability comparison, bootstrap deadline, shutdown gate, read/write timeout, retry on invalid hello, one-shot listener consumption, ACK bytes, nonblocking switch and return values are unchanged. The final Err pattern now binds the same error only for test diagnostics; release behavior is still return true.

The original owned child is awaited using the existing bounds and termination behavior. After natural status and the existing bounded stderr read, a scalar record logs PID, status.code() and captured stderr byte count before the original success/empty-stderr assertion. The assertion, cleanup sequencing and result precedence remain unchanged.
Only fixed markers were inserted before initialize and after its verified reply and verified tools/list reply. No extra request, retry, await, acceptance condition or deadline was introduced.
The actual Windows driver module is registered only under cfg(all(test,windows)); no test marker becomes normal UI or helper protocol output.

diagnosticLimits: This change adds observation only; it neither explains nor fixes the current actual helper stdout EOF.

original-helper-ended is emitted only after natural status and a successful bounded stderr read. A status/read error or timeout can still end without this marker; absence is not successful termination.
stderrBytes counts the bytes captured by the existing take(8193), not a proven full stream size if it exceeds that bound. It contains no stderr text.
The existing early protocol error can still be the final returned failure; the added marker preserves reached terminal facts in stderr without overriding the original error.
No Cargo, PowerShell, tests, actual Windows run, Agent or app was executed in this review.
